items.title: Spam protection for exhibitor registration
items.benefit: You asked for protection after spam sign-ups forced exhibitor registration to be switched off. Exhibitor registration now includes reCAPTCHA, so it can stay open.

items.title: Ticket order you control
items.benefit: Tickets now keep the order you set in the registration pipeline, even after you edit or add participant categories.

items.title: Aditus badges inside the app
items.benefit: With one setting, the app shows the custom badge page from Aditus, your registration partner, instead of the standard badge. Attendees scan the badge they actually registered with.

items.title: Lead downloads by exhibitor category
items.benefit: Switch lead downloads on or off for a whole exhibitor category or for a single exhibitor, instead of for every exhibitor at once.

items.title: Security questions for exhibitor events
items.benefit: Set your own questions that exhibitors must answer when they submit an event, and read the answers in the admin panel before you approve.

items.title: Product categories as session filters
items.benefit: Visitors can filter sessions by product category, with the same filter setup you already use for exhibitor events.

items.title: Activity categories only for exhibitors
items.benefit: A registration setting restricts exhibitors to choosing from your activity categories when they add product categories.

items.title: Sponsor pop-up through the API
items.benefit: Your exhibitor data feed can now switch an exhibitor's sponsor pop-up on or off through the API, with no manual edits in the admin panel.

items.title: Admin notifications in every language
items.benefit: Write each admin notification once per language and every visitor gets it in their own language, including visitors who are not logged in.

items.title: App pages for visitors who are not logged in
items.benefit: Show selected app pages only to visitors who are not logged in, and link them straight to the right sign-in page from your custom content.

items.title: Faster sponsor administration
items.benefit: The sponsor page in the admin panel, which you reported as slow, has been reworked to load faster.

items.title: German across the platform
items.benefit: German wording corrected and completed across the platform, using EuroTier 2024 as the reference and applied to every event.

items.title: Tax names in every language
items.benefit: Tax names on invoices and at checkout now follow the buyer's language, like the rest of registration.

items.title: Aditus badge settings restored
items.benefit: The Aditus custom badge setting is back in the admin panel, so you can manage it yourselves event by event.

items.title: Favourites and floor plan bookmarks in sync
items.benefit: Favouriting an exhibitor bookmarks their stand on the floor plan, and bookmarking a stand favourites the exhibitor, so visitors plan their visit once.

items.title: Clearer badge messages with Aditus
items.benefit: When a custom badge can't be loaded, visitors now see a clear explanation of what happened and what to do, instead of being sent silently to a different badge page.

items.title: Safer floor plan updates between web and app
items.benefit: After Agritechnica 2025, when an ExpoFP update reached the app before the web, we added a way to switch the floor plan source so web and app stay in step.

items.title: Hall and stand management for large events
items.benefit: Hall and stand lists in the floor plan admin sort naturally and let you select and remove many at once, built with Agritechnica's many halls in mind.

items.title: Past events stay available in the app
items.benefit: Visitors can reopen finished events in the app and still find their data. The fix followed a sync gap seen after Agritechnica 2025.

items.title: Private favourites for opted-out visitors
items.benefit: Visitors who opt out of networking can still favourite exhibitors, visitors and products on web and in the app. Their favourites stay private, in line with GDPR.

items.title: Brands attached across events on import
items.benefit: Exhibitor imports can attach existing brands across your events, so brands don't have to be rebuilt for each show.

items.title: Custom session filters in the API
items.benefit: Set and read your custom session filters through the Sessions API, with filter titles returned in the requested language.

items.title: Dedicated SAML single sign-on page
items.benefit: At your urgent request, SAML single sign-on now has its own settings page in the integrations catalogue.

next.title: Academic titles for EuroTier 2026
next.benefit: Academic titles captured at registration and shown next to participants' names, starting with a first release for EuroTier 2026.

next.title: Language filter for sessions and exhibitor events
next.benefit: Visitors filter sessions and exhibitor events by the language they are held in.

next.title: Session calendar: all-day sessions and track order
next.benefit: All-day sessions shown in their own row, and sessions kept in a stable track column as you scroll the day.

next.title: Cleaner web pages inside the EuroTier app
next.benefit: Web pages opened inside the app no longer load tracking scripts or show the cookie banner, in line with app store rules.

next.title: Reliable incremental sync of interaction statistics
next.benefit: Exhibitor and sponsor interaction statistics can be synced incrementally without missing late-arriving data.

next.title: Session audiences kept when cloning events
next.benefit: Session type visibility settings follow the cloned event correctly, as needed for DLG-Feldtage.

next.title: Private favourites: bulk removal
next.benefit: Removing many connections at once also respects private favourites.

section.title: What we built at your request
section.intro: Features your team asked for, delivered for Agritechnica, EuroTier, DLG-Feldtage and your other events. They are now part of the platform for every event you run. In the full timeline below, features you requested carry a Requested by DLG badge.
